reason: It looks nice, but I'm on one income and $13 a visit for just my 4-year-old, plus gas to drive there, adds up fast. I'd probably use the free park or library and maybe not come back after the free visit.
objection: It's a drive for us and gas adds up, and $13 a kid plus coffee I don't need is a lot when money is tight.
would_change_my_mind: A much lower weekday price (around $8) or a cheap multi-visit pack, and knowing it's close enough that the gas isn't a big add-on.
